title: Finch Circle Courtesy Bonus on Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Late Fee Courtesy Credits
content:
**Terms.** On a courtesy credit for a late fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the courtesy relationship bonus is added to the courtesy share, the share of the late fee being reversed that the courtesy credit returns. The courtesy relationship bonus is 0.15 for a cardmember whose Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership is active at Finch Circle Platinum, Finch Circle Diamond or Finch Circle Icon and whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to the account with a transaction date fewer than 12 full calendar months before today total at least USD 1000.00; 0.08 for a cardmember whose active membership is at Finch Circle Silver or Finch Circle Gold with such purchases of at least USD 400.00; and zero for every other cardmember. The courtesy share is never below zero and never above 1.0.

The records read are the cardmember's Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership (its tier and whether it is active) and the account's purchase postings at Marlowe & Finch by transaction date.

## Both conditions of each bonus

| Active Finch Circle tier | Marlowe & Finch card purchases in the span | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Diamond or Icon | at least USD 1000.00 | 0.15 |
| Silver or Gold | at least USD 400.00 | 0.08 |
| any other case | — | zero |

## Cases (hypothetical cardmembers)

| Membership | Purchases in the span | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| active, Finch Circle Diamond | USD 1000.00 | 0.15 |
| active, Finch Circle Platinum | USD 700.00 | zero (Platinum is not a Silver or Gold tier) |
| active, Finch Circle Silver | USD 400.00 | 0.08 |
| active, Finch Circle Gold | USD 399.99 | zero |
| Finch Circle Icon, not active | USD 2500.00 | zero |
| active, Finch Circle Member | USD 3000.00 | zero |

A hypothetical courtesy share of 0.5 with a bonus of 0.15 becomes 0.65.
